label: Rational authorship and epistemic ends in contingent creation
summary: Philosophical checkpoint at main 8083301a037428574d0e46b1064d8f6d858da377. Reuses #742 base-fixed net selection, #545/#555 necessitation and reason-closure boundaries, #1875 necessary bearer/contingent output and omission controls, #1380 knowledge discrimination, #737 and #1410 veracity boundaries. Distinguishes productive actual explanation, partial contrastive reasons and exhaustive determining reasons at the same whole-order explanandum. Practical authorship candidate: apprehended end, adoption for an actual reason, and intention-directed production distinguish purposive realization from post-hoc labeling and controlled lottery policy without necessarily explaining the exact endorsement contrast. Counterexample to treating the personal label as sufficient: an uncontrolled random selector within a reason-constrained policy. The same productive standard credits an impersonal producer; its modal/causal stability is compatible with reliable evidence. Normative candidate: deliberate systematic frustration of a conferred truth-directed epistemic capacity, without overriding justification, is contrary to faithfully realizing that specific end. Requires domain, normal use, genuine cognition and goodness; assertion truthfulness is not a trace-reliability theorem. No modal collapse or skepticism inferred from mere source contingency, and no actual divine application established. C2 concerns absence of n, not absence of distinct created effects. Note: docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md#rational-authorship-versus-brute-selection-2026-11-23. No new theorem, statement, definition, sourced claim, or support edge. Existing full-synthesis underdetermination retained; Review and repairs are recorded in PR-1911. Continuation (same date, proposed): docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md#can-direct-intentional-production-be-extrinsic-without-becoming-brute-2026-11-23. Read ST I q.19 a.5 and q.45 a.3/q.13 a.7 alongside q.14 a.8–9,11 and the prior #462 O'Connor/Huneeus comparison. Distinguish one-act rational order of willed means and ends from the causing of a separate act of willing. Test coarse intention versus content-specific production and merely permitted consequences. Rejected shortcut: success-defined productive relation entails the effect trivially, which does not demonstrate nontrivial efficacy of a specific intention. Compare A: a particular agent-directed productive transaction, not a separately caused executive state; B: specific content-adoption with independently intelligible intentional object and an explanatory role prior to realization, not an outcome-copying label. A can conditionally cover concrete existential dependence without settling the fact-level transaction's obtaining; B needs an account of contingent nonintrinsic adoption consistent with strict simplicity. The strong intrinsic difference principle is an additional premise, not entailed by the weak difference of the whole transaction or by absence of passive change. Productive self-knowledge needs actual direction/reference, not mere possibility knowledge or causal scope. Conditional no-mediator regress applies only to recursively demanded separate voluntary mediators; no proof of metaphysical possibility or full agency. The earlier underdetermination judgment remains; no new source binding or formal edge. Further continuation §§11–14: docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md#exemplar-as-practical-measure-can-specificity-belong-to-the-exercise-2026-11-23. ST I q.15 a.1–3 and q.14 a.8–9,15–16 give a positive distinction between the one cognitive principle and multiple understood exemplars, and between possible content and actually practical knowledge. SEP Action §4/Intention (secondary orientation) motivates practical measure rather than a separately caused executive event. Distinguish fixed intelligible content from variable operative role; test an intended equilateral triangle, lottery-selected triangle and misexecuted scalene intention with identical actual result. This is not a same-intrinsic-state model. A determinate specification has fulfillment conditions independently of the actual product; a world-label or successful output cannot establish its actual normative role. A nonintrinsically individuated productive exercise for a recognized exemplar is a positive hypothesis, not an implication of q.15. Exact disputed intrinsic-role supervenience versus a genuine same-intrinsic-actuality alternative pair with varying operative content. Same-source application to #1459 recipient-directed existence-willing and #1380 practical self-knowledge remains conditional. No new formal result or attributed claim; prior underdetermination retained. Further continuation §§15–18: docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md#active-power-immanent-operation-and-the-essential-object-of-an-act-2026-11-23. Aristotle Physics III.3 locates the shared motion in the movable (reuse existing typed readings); this does not establish no intrinsic changes in the mover. Aquinas De potentia q.1 a.1, q.3 a.15 fourth argument/ad 14–20, q.7 a.10 and ST I q.25/q.45 distinguish active principle from passive actualization, explicitly reject a transitive intermediary divine operation, and distinguish necessary immanent actuality from contingent effects. Grant–Spencer (2015), pp.12–15,40–42,53–56, distinguishes divine-act identity from essentiality of its secondary object. Reuse #555: identity/BeingCarriesAct plus secondary-object essentiality and strict content-specific efficacy would exclude an actual distinct effect's contingency; locating the effect in the patient does not by itself escape. Positive restricted-essentiality rationale: nonreceptive cognition and finite manifestations do not exhaust the divine primary good; no inference from nonexhaustion to multiple metaphysically possible choices without policy/possibility premises. Thin productive dependence plus exemplar conformity does not distinguish a coarse or blind policy from operative D-specific willing. A genuine directed exercise could be relationally individuated without a distinct intrinsic executive state, but its actual intentional-role and fact-level adequacy bridges are OPEN. Conditional textual preference for one immanent principle over a transitive intermediary, continued suspension about joint metaphysical applicability. Reuse #1731 IntentionalExemplarExtension, #1459 and #1380 without importing their open bridges. No new source claim or formal result. Further continuation §§19–22: docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md#restricted-object-essentiality-the-two-relations-and-particularity-of-the-recipient-2026-11-23. Newly read De veritate q.23 a.4 co./ad 2–3,6–8,11–16 (Latin [56440–56441] and English) and a.5 co./ad 1–3: Aquinas explicitly distinguishes the non-absolutely-necessary relation to the object as willed and the efficacy conditional; the productive respect presupposes the former in the order of understanding, without a contingent intermediary. This gives direct textual support for the proposed §8B architecture, not a metaphysical proof of nonintrinsic actual adoption. Expressive versus acquisitive end: a creature need not complete the source's good, but an essential rational policy could still require a unique realization; nonexhaustion or equally noble individual alternatives do not establish whole-order alternatives. New distributive-intention test: two deliberately produced cup gifts can each be intentionally made under a genuinely adopted recipient/production role without a pre-existing singular referent or separate intrinsic token for each. Actual individualized effect and nondeviant realization, not common ultimate giver or output-defined coverage, are required (reuse merged #1912 identity distinction). The same adopted role can be fulfilled by a different eligible product. Actual intentional production under that role leaves prior rigid-effect selection, #555 strict efficacy for that effect, and #1459 recipient-directed aboutness open. Maintain suspension about the actual nonintrinsic-adoption bridge, and parity for impersonal productive accounts. No new registered proof or sourced claim. Continuation §§23–30 (2026-11-24; baseline a55e21b51aae73115c95a998e32b4a6686eaa968): docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md#actual-direction-by-an-invariant-good-1953-2026-11-24. The third argument of ST I q.19 a.4 co./ad 4 supplies the strongest formative rationale: effects proceed through their actual mode of precontainment in the cause. Distinguish substitution of the same causal subject under esse/understanding identity from production in virtue of apprehended content D. Ordinary practical agency gives direct defeasible warrant for the latter relation; an actual-intellect, causal-form and direct-exercise account gives substantive cumulative warrant for active exemplarity at the proposed simple source. It requires no separate selecting event or regress of independently proved adoptions. Actual intellect and one power alone do not establish the formative relevance of the understood content. The equally selective impersonal producer retains the same existential-supply and primitive-exercise credit; a cognitive-but-nonoperative construction challenges the inference without certifying a full simple-source countermodel. A genuinely adopted invariant recipient role can explain intentional realization without selecting every rigid detail, while conditional permission does not initiate and necessarily efficacious categorical production excludes omission. Reuse q.14, q.19 a.2–3,5, q.45 a.3 and q.13 a.7, Aristotle NE VI.2, De anima III.9–10 and Metaphysics Theta.5 at their stated scopes. External pending #1957 in PR-1961 retains same-relation identity transfer while distinguishing relation-fact from source existence. Exact root connections: 608a262d with BX1/BX2 through 7bf9cb77 to B2; merged #1944 consumer 834ddcfa with its complete four-premise bundle to will 66aecdd7. No new support edge, formal result, pinned attribution or discharge of same-source/C2 obligations. Overall actual classical-creation application remains underdetermined; the positive interpretation and precise reopening condition supersede the generic practical-adoption test in this scope. That continuation was subsequently reviewed and published; its exact assessment and review are preserved in assessment_history. Continuation §§37–44 (2026-11-25), integrating #1941, #1953, #1971, #1978 and #1981 in the existing PR-1962: docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md#can-objective-finality-explain-a-contingent-order-without-apprehension-2026-11-25. Construct matched positive personal and impersonal accounts at the same source, whole-order target, intrinsic-invariance and nonnecessitating-power scope. Distinguish objective goodness, objective final causation, apprehension as good and actual governance by apprehended content. Objective finality can positively explain a particular exercise through its form-specific nature without constituting a motivating reason; neither source label supplies exhaustive contrast between equally eligible outcomes. Preserve equal permission for primitive productive exercises. Distinguish equality of one output, equality of a specified evidence profile and identity of constitutive explanatory roles. Rational direction is a substantive conditional gain only with warrant for its actual application, not from source cognition or output fit alone. The one-power cognitive-but-nonoperative comparison is no countermodel to the complete frozen CHANCE_3-excluding bundle. Reuse exact #555 and #1380 conditional bridges and omission controls; necessary bearer, invariant act, rigid-effect efficacy, factive complete knowledge and supervenience remain distinct premises. Link the companion q.79/q.77 finite-power composition control and failed actual-self-knowledge strengthening. Neither role plurality nor temporal immutability settles the strict-simple source case. Conditions for unequal adequacy and scoped equivalence, cumulative warrant, positive discriminators and explicit revision conditions are recorded together. Update existing argument A/B descriptions from their canonical spec, retaining all proof types and correcting the already-existing 834ddcfa consumer. No new Lean theorem, source claim, support edge or premise discharge; the actual ultimate application remains underdetermined. Further continuation on 2026-11-25, §§45–48: investigates the grounding of objective finality rather than merely granting it. Reuses PR-1646 organizational due-capacity work, its causal recurrence and biological distinctions; preserves proper function, due good, optimality, cognition and practical direction as distinct. The retained underived source cannot be explained as maintained by its contingent recipients; the strongest impersonal response instead gives recipient forms through an intrinsically specified generative power. Reconstructs the positive original-intellectual-ordering argument and isolates its received-versus-original ordering premise, with Aristotle/Aquinas present-form and natural-appetite readings. Rejects absent-future and archer shortcuts, and tests native competence versus successful support at one fixed bearer/end. Positive local function warrant is retained without a complete ultimate-source realization, global explanatory equivalence or impersonal defeat. Existing local teleology and due-goodness bridges keep their exact premise bundles; no new formal edge. Simplicity/forms continuation on published 1d6b7551eb166b263a40889659a9cb38fab1382b and main 93e7ee882fba969b62df982486a1b8ec36217c57: §§49–53 of the same note test whether the strongest generative rival entails composition. De potentia q.7 a.1 ad 1, 7–8 distinguishes source-side unity from effect plurality; q.3 a.16 distinguishes required heterogeneous parts from the choice of a total order. Q.14 a.6 supplies a source-of-differences requirement shared by both accounts, while q.15 presupposes cognition. The positive one-nature proposal and actual intellectual account retain the same scope and primitive permission. This source/warrant refinement adds no formal edge or new pinned claim. The current assessment supersedes only the scoped next-test wording; prior qualified reviews remain in history. Three-argument continuation in optimal-creation-choice §§54–58 develops joint good-directed fit and proper manifestation as a positive cumulative personal case, tests the strongest intrinsic-final replacement, and corrects the omission scope: necessary role fulfillment can coexist with joint absence of the actual contingent population through replacement. The table is an unverified structural surrogate using existing frame vocabulary. No full ultimate constitution or exclusive intellectual bridge is established.
blocker: Identify the actual form-bearing productive principle: warrant giving as the proper manifestation of intellectual appetite under the independently characterized good, or substantiate the rival’s intrinsic joint manifestation under the same source constraints. A discriminatory exclusion would show required received restriction, external specification, real composition or incompatible necessitation in the strongest rival itself. For modal claims, fix rigid-recipient, actual-population or total-noncreation scope; actual-population incompatibility with necessary role fulfillment additionally needs exhaustive restriction to actual recipients. Another matching-output example, finite-effect count or unqualified demand for exhaustive contrast does not settle the issue.

current_assessment.assessment: The personal account gains a precise positive unity: apprehended recipient good can specify both the jointly suitable means and the proper productive activity of intellectual appetite. Mere component supply, an outcome-defined end and nonoperative cognition fail the stated explanatory tasks. The strongest intrinsic-final rival instead proposes one recipient-directed joint manifestation whose independently fixed good constrains its constitutive relations; the finite-measure, efficient-cause, proxy and inquiry tests do not exclude it. Necessarily fulfilled role-level purpose can permit replacement of every actual contingent recipient, so #1941 B does not by itself require total noncreation. This helps both accounts and leaves selection of this realization and #1380 factive-knowledge obligations open. Shared dependencies preserve cumulative warrant but do not supply the exclusive intellectual bridge. No unconditional comparison of the complete ultimate constitutions, global equivalence or rival defeat is established.

assessment_history.assessment: The strongest impersonal account supplies actual productive explanation, objective finality and sophisticated selection through its own nature and nonnecessitating powers. The strongest personal account additionally makes apprehended goodness the actual formative and final measure of the same exercise; that is a substantive explanatory difference when warranted, not a consequence of matching outputs or merely possessing intellect. Both may stop in a primitive exercise without thereby supplying exhaustive determining contrast for every eligible alternative. Necessary rational existence does not alone collapse the effect into necessity, while invariant act plus strict efficacy for the same rigid effect does. The one-act intentional account offers a substantive constitutive rationale without separate executive events; its strict-simple application, and the corresponding unitary nonoperative rival, remain disputed. Existing output/profile tests and source-level cognition do not settle actual rational authorship. Overall ultimate application remains underdetermined; no impersonal defeat or premise discharge is claimed.

A concrete unitary impersonal account, or a defended incompatibility of that account with a shared requirement, would revise the comparison. Further matched output assignments or adding unused self-knowledge do not advance this test.

assessment_history.assessment: Existing intervention-sensitive organization and selected-effect work give positive grounds for some local functions and biological good-for judgments without apprehension by the functional part. They do not establish Best, cognitive exclusion, or ultimate sourcehood. The retained underived, necessary and invariant source cannot be maintained by its contingent recipients, so that local loop is not its own reason for production. The strongest impersonal reply is an intrinsically specified generative nature that gives recipients their forms and due capacities. The strongest personal reply makes apprehended recipient good the actual formative measure, giving a substantive reason for communication without need. Original-ordering exclusivity remains the disputed bridge: the present-form account, archer and absent-future tests do not establish it. The prior ultimate-source underdetermination is retained with strengthened positive local grounding and a precise source-application requirement. No global equivalence, impersonal defeat, actual governance or premise discharge is claimed. The maintenance-transfer conclusion uses underivedness and the specified productive relation, not necessity alone.

assessment_history.assessment: Plural effect forms do not establish plural intrinsic constituents: the new De potentia q.7 a.1 control distinguishes one productive actuality from its many termini, while Aquinas retains intellectual production. The strongest impersonal proposal originates an integrated differentiated whole through its own unreceived efficacy, including real rational recipients, rather than borrowing preconfigured matter. The intellectual account supplies differentiated contents through one actual understanding and, where warranted, makes the apprehended good the formative measure. Q.14 a.6 requires the source to account for the distinguishing determinations; q.15 explains ideas given cognition rather than independently proving it. Whole-order differentiation, alternative orders and actual exercise are separate obligations. The counting objection fails against the strengthened proposal, but neither ultimate constitution is established; actual apprehension and formative use remain distinct, and no global equivalence or rival defeat is claimed.

Counting objects, effect forms or descriptive parameters, or inserting preexisting matter, cannot settle that test.
